verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the Control Plane generates the MCP server itself from an OpenAPI document or a TypeScript Functions project. The gram CLI stages OpenAPI documents and Functions, then pushes and monitors deployments, and the dashboard tracks deployment history and offers a playground for testing the hosted server. No protocol plumbing is involved. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the generation works as described, detail on how OpenAPI operations map to tools, and custom-code support beyond TypeScript.
